verdict.rationale: Data storage location is a fair privacy question for a local LLM app, so the axis applies. The evidence shows local, offline processing: RAG runs 'entirely offline' and voice data 'never leaves your device'. It also shows llmster can run on servers or cloud instances. None of this documents a product control for choosing a storage location, region or residency. Picking the machine that hosts LM Studio is a user-side or host-platform arrangement and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
